### [PROJECTS](https://pingfanhu.com/projects)

**`surveydown` Survey Platform** - *Flagship Project of the Helveston Lab at GWU* \hfill 2024-2025

- Developed `surveydown`, an open-source R package for programmable and reproducible surveys, architecting system integration across Quarto, Shiny, and PostgreSQL. Responsible for UI development, backend SQL architecture, and template maintenance, now having 150+ stars on GitHub and 6000+ downloads on CRAN.
- Published a journal article in *Plos ONE* with 1000+ views. Presented at Posit Conference 2025. Awarded 2nd prize and profiled by GW Engineering.

**`sdstudio` Survey GUI** - *Companion Project of `surveydown`* \hfill 2025

- Developed `sdstudio` as GUI and SQL support to `surveydown`. Responsible for system design, UI/UX development, survey preview embedding, and backend SQL architecture, now having 200+ downloads on CRAN.
- Proposing a conference presentation at GW OSCON 2026.

**BEV Smart Charging Adoption Project** - *Joint Project between GWU, UC Davis & UC Irvine* \hfill 2023-2024

- Performed survey fielding, data wrangling, and discrete choice modeling. Collected and filtered 1300+ valuable responses from Meta and Dynata throughout the U.S. with 100% BEV ownership to ensure data quality. Leveraged mixed logit models to estimate consumer preferences and sensitivities to various smart charging program attributes.
- Published a journal article in *IOP Science*, 2 conference papers in *IEEE* and *TRB*, with 300+ views altogether.

**Smart Charging Cost-Efficiency Project** - *Joint Project between GWU, UC Davis & UC Irvine* \hfill 2025-2026

- Performed Monte Carlo simulation to evaluate the BEV usage status quo. Processed grid supply data from NREL's Cambium model across all 18 grids nationwide. Simulated charging sessions to quantify cost savings with various smart charging strategies.
- Proposing a journal paper to *Applied Energy*.
